* **Privacy Policy (`tray.io/privacy`):** 
  > *"We are Tray.ai, Inc. (“we”, “us” or “our”) and we provide a platform that allows you to easily automate complex processes in your organization (“Services”)."*
* **Master Subscription Agreement (`tray.io/terms`):** 
  > *"This Tray.ai Master Subscription Agreement (“Agreement”) is a legal agreement between Tray.ai, Inc. (“Tray”) and you or the entity that you represent..."*
